title: Scots pine cone
description: A warm brown elongated oval cone with broad woody scales and a gently pointed tip.

title: Black pine cone
description: A stout dark brown cone with glossy raised scale centers and a rounded base.

title: Stone pine cone
description: A large egg-shaped cone with thick chestnut-colored scales and a blunt crown.

title: Maritime pine cone
description: An elongated reddish brown cone with sharply raised angular scale tips.

title: Aleppo pine cone
description: A slender tawny cone with smooth overlapping scales and a curved short stalk.

title: Ponderosa pine cone
description: A broad open cone with honey-brown scales ending in small pointed prickles.

title: Sugar pine cone
description: A very long cylindrical cone with loose layered scales and a tapering tip.

title: White pine cone
description: A narrow curved cone with thin pale brown scales and a delicate tapered end.

title: Lodgepole pine cone
description: A small asymmetrical cinnamon-brown cone with tightly closed pointed scales.

title: Bristlecone pine cone
description: A small oval cone with dark scale centers and fine curled bristle tips.

title: Norway spruce cone
description: A long warm brown cylinder with thin overlapping papery scales and a rounded tip.

title: Blue spruce cone
description: A slender pale tan cone with wavy diamond-shaped scales and fine weathered edges.

title: Sitka spruce cone
description: A light buff cone with loosely layered thin scales and softly ruffled edges.

title: Black spruce cone
description: A small dark purple-brown cone with rounded compact scales and an egg-shaped outline.

title: Douglas fir cone
description: A medium brown cone with distinctive three-pronged bracts projecting between rounded scales.

title: Western hemlock cone
description: A tiny oval cone with thin amber-brown scales opening into a delicate layered form.

title: Larch cone
description: A small upright rosette-like cone with open russet scales and a neatly rounded base.

title: Deodar cedar cone
description: A barrel-shaped woody cone with tightly stacked gray-brown scales and a flat rounded crown.

title: Cypress cone
description: A round woody ball with large polygonal gray-brown plates separated by dark seams.

title: Giant sequoia cone
description: A small egg-shaped cone with thick russet shield-like scales and short projecting centers.

title: Coast redwood cone
description: A tiny rounded reddish-brown cone with thick wrinkled scales and deep narrow seams.

title: Bald cypress cone
description: A rough spherical woody cone with irregular muted brown plates and a short attached stalk.

title: Layered brown cone
description: A dark brown oval woody cone with loosely overlapping blunt scales and a short attached stalk.

title: Banksia seed cone

title: Sheoak cone

title: Magnolia seed cone

title: Papery hop cone
description: A pale yellow-green papery cone with overlapping delicate bracts and a tapered tip.

title: Dry teasel head
description: An elongated tan seedhead with dense prickly compartments and a few long attached curved basal bracts.

title: Sweetgum seed ball

title: Plane tree seed ball
description: A round tawny seed ball with a dense finely bristled surface and a short attached stalk.

title: Oak acorn

title: Long acorn

title: Bur oak acorn
description: A round brown acorn held in a deep heavily fringed woody cup.

title: Cork oak acorn

title: Valonia acorn
description: A broad brown acorn in an oversized cup with long angular recurved woody scales.

title: Walnut in shell

title: Black walnut in shell

title: Hazelnut in shell

title: Chestnut
description: A glossy reddish-brown chestnut with a broad pale basal patch and a small tufted pointed tip.

title: Almond in shell

title: Macadamia in shell

title: Beech nut
description: A small sharply three-sided glossy reddish-brown nut with a pale pointed tip.

title: Hickory nut

title: Dry beech cupule

title: Hazelnut in dry husk

title: Peanut pod

title: Eucalyptus capsule

title: Bottlebrush capsule

title: Hakea seedpod

title: Jacaranda seedpod

title: Dry milkweed pod

title: Dry wisteria pod

title: Twisted open pod

title: Carob pod
